title: Star · R4-10 — ⋯ menu icons for the private-testing items
subtitle: A candidate with a private testing (Alex Kim). “Change private day or time” gets the calendar icon (ti-calendar, as Color Belt’s “Change day or time” and Star’s own “Set private testing”); “Back to the testing day” gets the calendar-with-a-day icon (ti-calendar-event), so the Undo arrow means only Undo and Restore again (v1.048 (13)). Words, order and everything else in the menu stay the same.

items.caption: PC 1280×800, Alex Kim’s ⋯. Change private day or time uses Edit’s pencil; Back to the testing day uses Undo’s arrow (same as Undo payment below it).

columns.label: After

items.caption: PC 1280×800. ti-calendar on Change private day or time; ti-calendar-event on Back to the testing day.

columns.note: Both icons exist in @tabler/icons-react (IconCalendar, IconCalendarEvent). A candidate without a private testing keeps “Set private testing” with ti-calendar, as today. The menu looks the same at every size; only the row height changes on touch.

footer: Star testing · rolling check pass 1, Step A (plan OK’d 2026-11-06). Preview screenshots (fake database, admin, Fall Star Testing). The “After” column is drawn over the real page by a small script (mock-stepA.js) — nothing in the app was changed. Amber = what changes; green = the change.
